name: gearshift
description: Routes each prompt to Haiku, Sonnet or Opus by difficulty, and triages prompts sent while the agent is busy

classifier_model.title: Classifier model
classifier_model.description: Model that labels prompts; empty uses Claude Code's own small fast model

triage_enabled.title: Triage prompts sent mid-run
triage_enabled.description: Decide whether a prompt typed while the agent works should interrupt, steer or wait

triage_unsure.title: When triage is unsure
triage_unsure.description: queue waits for the current task; steer hands it to the running task
